values.note: Campsites $45 a day, first Friday in May to last Sunday in September, one rate for everyone (no county-resident rate); $60 a night on the Halloween Harvest Festival dates (Sept 25-26, 2026). A Muskegon County vehicle permit is required May 1 - Sept 30: $7 a day or $25 for the season. Cancellation $10 at 7+ business days; within 6 days the first night or $75, whichever is less.

values.note: First Friday in May through the last Sunday in September (2026: May 1 - Sept 27).

values.note: 235 modern sites, open and shaded, in forested dunes; 33 with 50-amp; some sites can't be reserved and are taken at the campground office.

sites.source: https://muskegoncountyparks.org/pioneer-park/ ('The park features 235 modern campsites with open and shaded areas') + goingtocamp resources, read 2026-10-22. The stored 60-ft maximum came from note prose; no county page or booking attribute states a length, so it is cleared.

values.note: Modern ADA restrooms and showers; sanitary dumping station; ice and firewood at the campground office. Cell service is extremely limited and there is no internet.

facilities.source: https://muskegoncountyparks.org/pioneer-park/ ('modern ADA restrooms and showers, a sanitary dumping station'; 'cell service is extremely limited in the campground and there is no internet'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online only (no phone reservations); the 2026 season opened for booking on January 2 at 8am. Non-reservable sites are taken in person at the campground office before 10am. ADA sites are requested by email or phone (231-744-3580). Check-out 1pm.

We do not accept reservations over the phone'; 'Non-reservable campsites must be reserved before 10:00 am in person at the campground office') + make-a-reservation/ ('calling the park office at 231-744-3580') + camping-rules/ ('Check-out time is at 1:00 p.m.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Muskegon County park on the Lake Michigan shore at 1563 N. Scenic Dr., North Muskegon, with 2,000 ft of beach reached by stairs, overlook decks, courts and a playground; sites sit in forested sand dunes. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the county's pages: 235 sites with water and electric, $45/day (one rate, no resident discount), open first Friday in May to last Sunday in September, online-only booking on goingtocamp. Added 50-amp (33 sites), the $7/day vehicle pass as entrance, flush toilets, no Wi-Fi, some non-reservable sites, booking notes. Cleared derived 60-ft maximum (no length published). Note trimmed of field facts. Phone 231-744-3580 is the only number published and the county calls it 'the park office'; no separate Pioneer Park number.
